name: documentation-agent
description: Autonomous technical documentation agent. Generates structured documentation from source code, API schemas and architecture descriptions. Produces README files, API reference docs, architecture decision records and changelogs aligned with documentation standards.

skills.name: README Generation
skills.description: Generates a structured README.md from a project description, source code or repository context. Covers installation, usage, configuration, examples and contributing guidelines.
examples: generate a README for this project

skills.name: API Documentation
skills.description: Generates API reference documentation from source code, function signatures or OpenAPI schemas. Produces endpoint descriptions, parameter tables, request/response examples and error codes.
examples: generate API documentation for this module
write docs for these REST endpoints
document this API from the source code

skills.name: Changelog Generation
skills.description: Generates a structured CHANGELOG.md from git commit history, pull request descriptions or release notes. Follows Keep a Changelog format with categorized entries for features, fixes, breaking changes and deprecations.
examples: generate a changelog from these commits
create a changelog entry for this release

skills.name: Architecture Decision Record
skills.description: Generates Architecture Decision Records (ADR) documenting technical decisions, their context, alternatives considered and consequences. Follows the MADR (Markdown Architectural Decision Records) format.
examples: write an ADR for choosing PostgreSQL over MongoDB
create a technical decision record for this design choice
